mapper.sql: id, submission_id, round_no, submission_version, decision, reason, before_status, after_status, reviewed_by, reviewed_at
mapper.select: SELECT log.id, log.submission_id, log.round_no, log.submission_version, log.decision, log.reason, log.before_status, log.after_status, log.reviewed_by, COALESCE(NULLIF(reviewer.nickname, ''), NULLIF(reviewer.name, ''), reviewer.cas_id) AS reviewer_name, log.reviewed_at FROM submission_review_log log LEFT JOIN `user` reviewer ON reviewer.id = log.reviewed_by WHERE log.submission_id = #{submissionId} ORDER BY log.round_no DESC, log.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
